invariants.rationale: Method likely expects non-null input to avoid NullPointerException when passing to HoodieListData.lazy.
Processing methods often expect input lists to be non-empty for work to be meaningful.
List.size() is always non-negative in Java.
It is often expected that lists of objects do not contain null elements for data processing.
Assures that the type of 'records' is a List as required by the method signature.
